query:
SELECT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM pull_request p
               LEFT JOIN UNNEST($2::uuid[], $3::bigint[], $4::timestamptz[])
                   AS r (id, version, at) ON r.id = p.id
               WHERE (p.issue_id = $1 OR r.id IS NOT NULL)
                 AND (r.id IS NULL OR p.version <> r.version OR p.updated_at > r.at
                      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review_thread t
                                 WHERE t.pull_request_id = p.id AND t.updated_at > r.at)
                      -- Two of the issue's pull requests can have one head commit: the last
                      -- read of it is the one its runs are stamped with.
                      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM check_run c
                                 WHERE c.repository_id = p.repository_id
                                   AND c.head_sha = p.head_sha
                                   AND c.updated_at > coalesce(
                                       (SELECT max(h.checks_read)
                                        FROM UNNEST($5::text[], $6::timestamptz[])
                                            AS h (sha, checks_read)
                                        WHERE h.sha = p.head_sha),
                                       r.at)))
           ) AS "written!"
